C2.rule: B-16 C2 (addendum 1, item 1(a)): saved held-out predictions of world_v2_b10stk; distance from P_d1 of features.parquet after joining by AOI and coordinates; M1cd -> M3nd by band with the band's yardstick and the overall one; 4,000 draws of location groups (models fixed, seed 20261105)

B7.rule: B-16 B7: cells of the v41 table assessable by GFM; EMS as the reference; hit rate P(GFM=1|EMS=1), false-alarm ratio P(EMS=0|GFM=1), CSI a/(a+b+c), Cohen's kappa

B9a.rule: B-16 B9 (a): each of the 200 reassignments of B-7 (composition rebuilt) as the placebo; Rp_j = [SSE_ref,j - SSE_names,j] / (N D) (centred: SSE(M1s) - SSE_cent,j); 95% interval of R - Rp_j from 4,000 draws of location groups (models fixed, seed 20261105, same draws for all j); verdict from decide of world_aggregate with that interval as the placebo interval

B9d.rule: B-16 B9 (d): coder 1 = the codes of v44 (first coding), coder 2 = v57b (a model of another developer); Cohen's kappa by class on the excerpts coded by both; flow from the v44 sample

B8.rule: B-16 B8 (addendum 1, item 10): within 500 m, Se in {0.6, 0.8, 1.0} and Sp in {0.99, 0.995, 1.0} for the ground of water-related names and other ground separately (81 combinations); corrected count a = (a_obs - (1 - Sp) N) / (Se + Sp - 1), impossible if <= 0 or >= N; corrected OR = adjusted OR x corrected crude OR / observed crude OR; rows of each estimator (AOIs with variation)

B6.rule: B-16 B6 (addendum 1, item 8): held-out predictions of world_v2_lexfix (primary, models fixed); cells joined to cells.parquet by AOI and float32 coordinates; R with the stratum's or target's own yardstick BS(M0) - BS(M1); 4,000 draws of location groups (seed 20261105); capped EMS estimate of Eq. (2) on the v37 table (frozen reading) restricted to the stratum's AOIs

B5.without_EMSR052_EMSR130: existing value (Table S29: 1.10, 0.83-1.41); no new computation
B5.rule: B-16 B5 (addendum 1, item 7): restricted wild cluster score bootstrap over location groups; efficient score of the term adjusted for the other coefficients with AOI effects profiled out; W = (sum s)^2 / sum s^2; Webb six-point weights, 9999 draws, seed 20261105, same weights at every delta0; p = (1 + #{W* >= W}) / (1 + B); 95% interval = delta0 on a grid of log odds ratios (-1.6 to 1.6, step 0.01) with p > 0.05

B9b.rule: B-16 B9 (b): frozen-reading refit of B1; block = the languages the lexicon assigns to the country of the nearest settlement; contributions sum(e)/N; top ten location groups by gamma_g as in B2

B9c.rule: B-16 B9 (c): frozen-reading refit of B1 (models fixed); (i) nearest settlement not on whole arc-minutes in both coordinates; (ii) feature code PPL; (iii) GeoNames modification date before the AOI's event date; (iv) the block the lexicon assigns reads the first language of the country in countryInfo.txt (Norway excluded, as in the frozen reading); 4,000 draws of location groups

B2.rule: B-16 B2: the five location groups with the largest gamma_g = ((e_g - Delta n_g)/N)^2 for M1c -> M3n (frozen reading, B1 point refit) removed one at a time and all five together from training and evaluation; stage 2 refitted (unweighted, started from the full fit); base predictions fixed

B1.rule: B-16 B1 (addendum 1, items 1-3): stage-2 design of the primary split re-dumped locally (world_v2_b16_stage2_local); frozen reading; super-clusters = location groups (5 km) merged by shared activation; 500 multinomial draws of super-clusters (seed 20261105 + b) weighting training and evaluation cells, stage 2 refitted with weights from the unweighted fit; base predictions fixed; Fieller 90% interval from the draws' covariance; few-cluster rule of B3 with super-clusters as units

pigeonhole_refit.units: smaller of location groups and activations

B3.rule: B-16 B3 (addendum 1, item 5): nu(theta) = (sum gamma)^2 / sum gamma^2 from the unit contributions to L+(theta); theta_U and nu iterated with t(nu - 1) until the change < 1e-6; no upper limit if nu - 1 < 1 or the Fieller interval is unbounded; z and t(nu) with the same nu; G* = nu at theta 0

B4.rule: B-16 B4: _or_conversions of v73 (curves of B2 of B-13, four no-effect references); bands other than all ground are not converted (the curves are for effects on all ground). For A3, the margin (0.05 D) is also translated to an effect that removes flooding, with the curves of C2 of B-9 (v64.c2_negative, the same interpolation and references)
